scenes.conflict: Pell refuses to commit without proof of how the relic wakes, and Odalys resents being handed only a fragment of the plan. Marguerite's habit of withholding her script breeds friction.
scenes.goal: Marguerite wants to set the heist in motion and keep her crew safe by controlling every detail of the plan.
scenes.outcome: Pell is sent to confirm the awakening conditions and Odalys to learn the reliquary's lock design in the Sunken Arcade. Marguerite still hides the fallback plan, which leaves the crew divided.
scenes.summary: In the mirror-lined wings of the Gilded Lantern Theatre, Marguerite unveils the commission to steal the Obsidian Earring from the Duchess's ball. She gives Pell and Odalys only their narrow tasks and keeps the full script to herself.
scenes.title: A Commission by Footlight

scenes.conflict: Odalys's pride makes her flaunt her skill in front of the brokers. Severin's whispered network works through the same brokers who sell to her.
scenes.goal: Odalys wants the lock schematic. Severin wants to learn who is moving against the earring so the Order can ensure it awakens.
scenes.outcome: Odalys leaves with the schematic, unaware that Severin has bribed the brokers to sabotage her tools. Severin sends a whispered warning of the heist toward the Aerie.
scenes.summary: Odalys returns to the Sunken Arcade's drowned mezzanines to buy schematics for the reliquary's glass-and-clockwork lock. Severin Hollow, posing as an appraiser, recognises the shape of her errand.
scenes.title: Lantern-Light Bargains

scenes.conflict: Ilvane's vanity makes her wave off Severin's hints that the relic is dangerous, but it also makes her receptive to his flattery that bright display will make her envied.
scenes.goal: Ilvane wants to show the earring at her ball and catch the thieves she expects. Severin wants the relic exposed to the crowd and bright light.
scenes.outcome: Ilvane orders the chandeliers blazing at full lightning and quietly doubles her guard to trap the thieves. Severin leaves satisfied that the light will do his work.
scenes.summary: In the empty ballroom beneath the moored aether balloons, Duchess Ilvane rehearses her display of the earring. Severin, arriving as an appraiser, flatters her into keeping the reliquary under the brightest chandeliers.
scenes.title: Flattery Above the Fog

scenes.conflict: Thaddeus holds Pell at the end of his lantern staff and will not bend his oath. Pell's fear of acting on partial knowledge makes him linger over the records instead of leaving.
scenes.goal: Pell wants to confirm when the earring awakens and sleeps. Thaddeus wants to seize the trespassing traitor and secure the Vault.
scenes.outcome: A patch of rotting felt tears loose and a shadow drifts toward the walls. Thaddeus lunges to hold it back, and Pell escapes through the gap with a few pages and a signal lantern lit in the fog. Thaddeus is left more hostile and more aware that his Vault is failing.
scenes.summary: Pell slips into the Velvet Vault to consult the Guild's old relic records and is cornered by Warden Thaddeus Brass, who calls him a traitor but cannot hide that the felt walls are failing. Pell snatches a handful of pages.
scenes.title: The Warden's Ledger

scenes.conflict: Thaddeus's tracking is relentless and his oath leaves no room for bargaining. Marguerite, keeping her fallback to herself, improvises alone and leaves Odalys exposed.
scenes.goal: Thaddeus wants to capture the Curtain Call Company. Marguerite wants to protect her crew without revealing the plan.
scenes.outcome: The crew escapes through the trapdoors, but Odalys is nearly caught covering the retreat. Thaddeus swears to follow the heist to its end, and Marguerite tightens her secrecy.
scenes.summary: Thaddeus, following Pell's trail through the fog by signal lantern, raids the Gilded Lantern Theatre. Marguerite turns trapdoors, mirrors and counterweights against him.
scenes.title: The Warden Takes the Stage

scenes.conflict: Odalys is reckless and insists she can repair the tools herself. Severin's zealotry dismisses the risk to the people at the ball.
scenes.goal: Odalys wants to repair her tools and learn who sabotaged them. Severin wants to keep her tools failing at the moment the reliquary must open.
scenes.outcome: Odalys patches her tools and ignores the warning in the sabotage. She keeps her risk to herself, and Severin sends word to the Aerie that the lock will jam.
scenes.summary: Back in the Sunken Arcade, Odalys finds her picks and clockwork tools quietly ruined. She confronts Severin, who denies everything in a whisper.
scenes.title: Rust in the Gears

scenes.conflict: Ilvane recognises Marguerite's wit and plays along, while Thaddeus watches from the lamp lines. Pell, uncertain of his plan, cannot start dimming the lamps.
scenes.goal: Marguerite wants to get her crew to the reliquary unseen. Ilvane wants to spring her trap on the thieves.
scenes.outcome: The thieves reach the reliquary but are boxed in by Ilvane's guards and clockwork attendants. The earring begins to hum under the crowd's shadows.
scenes.summary: The crew enters the floating ball in masks and borrowed finery under the blazing chandeliers. Ilvane's guards close in on the reliquary, and a Guild skiff moored to the lamp lines carries Thaddeus aboard.
scenes.title: A Masked Entrance

scenes.conflict: The jammed lock defeats Odalys, Ilvane's guards threaten the crew, and Severin whispers the Duchess into keeping the lights bright. Marguerite's instinct is to improvise alone.
scenes.goal: Marguerite wants the earring out of the reliquary before it awakens. Severin wants the awakening to complete and the heist to fail.
scenes.outcome: The earring begins to devour shadows. Ilvane sees her own shadow thinning, and Marguerite realises she cannot save the ball without sharing her plan.
scenes.summary: Odalys's sabotaged lock jams as the crowd's shadows spill under the blazing chandeliers. The Obsidian Earring stirs, and the aether lamps begin to flicker. Guests grow pale.
scenes.title: Chandeliers Against Shadows

scenes.conflict: Pell must act on partial knowledge without certainty. Ilvane's guards still try to stop the crew, and Odalys must swallow her pride and step back from the lock.
scenes.goal: Marguerite wants to get the earring into felt-lined darkness. Pell wants to shield the guests' shadows while the crew moves it.
scenes.outcome: Pell shuts the shutters and drapes the guests in felt, and Odalys rigs an escape along the mooring lines. Marguerite lifts the earring with the backup method, and Ilvane, her shadow thinning, orders the lights put out and the relic surrendered.
scenes.summary: Marguerite hands the real plan to Pell and Odalys. Odalys retreats from her jammed lock and passes the job to Marguerite's backup, and Pell dims the lamps and drapes the guests in felt-lined screens.
scenes.title: The Script Handed Over

scenes.conflict: Severin's zealotry drives him toward the light even as his follower grows pale. His suppressed doubts break through, and Ilvane's vanity makes her hesitate to admit the danger.
scenes.goal: Severin wants to push the earring back into the light. Pell wants to keep the crowd's shadows shielded long enough for the crew to carry the relic out.
scenes.outcome: Severin abandons the plan and pulls his follower into the felt-draped dark. Pell's screens hold, and the earring sleeps again once it is hidden from the light.
scenes.summary: As the ballroom dims under Pell's felt screens, a hooded follower of the Order begins to fade. Severin must choose between completing the awakening and saving her.
scenes.title: The Follower Who Faded

scenes.conflict: Thaddeus's oath tells him to arrest them, but he has seen them quiet the relic where the Guild's methods were failing. Marguerite must trust him with the earring's fate.
scenes.goal: Thaddeus wants to arrest the thieves and secure the earring. Marguerite wants to deliver the relic to felt-lined darkness.
scenes.outcome: Thaddeus steps aside and guides the crew toward the Velvet Vault, bending his oath for the first time.
scenes.summary: Thaddeus meets the crew at the mooring lines as they carry the quieted earring down. Seeing them keep it in felt-lined darkness, he lets them take it to the Vault.
scenes.title: Warden at the Mooring Lines

scenes.conflict: Thaddeus's pride resists admitting the Guild needs help, and Pell is still branded a traitor.
scenes.goal: Thaddeus wants to reseal the earring safely. Marguerite wants her crew free of the Guild's cells.
scenes.outcome: The earring is sealed in fresh felt, and Thaddeus agrees to let the crew help repair the Vault. The Guild's oath is eased for the first time and the crew is no longer hunted.
scenes.summary: The crew and Thaddeus carry the earring into the Velvet Vault and reseal it. Thaddeus admits that the failing felt walls need outside help.
scenes.title: Into Felt and Silence

scenes.conflict: Her vanity resists confessing the display endangered her guests, and Thaddeus's rigid oath leaves little room for mercy.
scenes.goal: Ilvane wants to salvage her house's standing. Thaddeus wants to account for the guests who lost shadows.
scenes.outcome: Ilvane surrenders the reliquary to the Guild and pays for the guests' care. She is humbled but values her life above her rank.
scenes.summary: In the daylight-dim ballroom, a pale Ilvane faces Thaddeus and the thinned guests. She gives up her trophy and her pose.
scenes.title: The Duchess Without a Mask

scenes.conflict: Severin's devotion pulls him toward the Order and Odalys's anger pulls her toward revenge.
scenes.goal: Severin wants to save his follower and face his doubts. Odalys wants to end the sabotage in her old market.
scenes.outcome: Severin names the brokers and gives up the Order's plan, and Odalys, no longer proving her worth, lets the Guild deal with the rest.
scenes.summary: Severin returns to the Sunken Arcade with his faded follower and meets Odalys, who has come to mend what the brokers broke.
scenes.title: The Priest in the Drowned Gallery

scenes.conflict: Marguerite's old habit of controlling the plan returns, and she must resist it.
scenes.goal: Marguerite wants to hold her found family together. Pell and Odalys want to be trusted partners.
scenes.outcome: She shares the script with her crew. Pell stays on as a confident planner and Odalys accepts being supported, so the troupe ends as a family that shares the stage.
scenes.summary: The crew gathers at the Gilded Lantern Theatre. Marguerite lays out her whole script and invites them to rewrite it.
scenes.title: The Script Shared

logline: When a crew of stage-magician thieves tries to steal the Obsidian Earring from a duchess's floating ball, they must learn to trust one another and their Guild enemies before a cult and a vain host let the relic awaken and devour every guest's shadow.
theme: Trust is the only light that does not cast a devouring shadow
title: The Velvet Vault
